country_decisions: CFG-INT-001: authorized cross-institution exchanges and contract versions (exchange relationships and the integration's purposes, approved by two officials; none ship).
CFG-DAT-001: retention and disclosure of the exchange log and receipts.

library.title: Close an inter-institution referral
library.intro: Close a referral once it has been reported on or declined.
library.filled_by: An official of the receiving institution.
library.authority: Each institution's own: the referral is a case of the receiving institution's referral procedure, worked by its own officials.

deviations.what: The owner is each institution itself: it adopts the cross-institution templates as its own procedures (xi.<template>.<institution>), drafted by one of its officials and approved by another; the case belongs to the institution that receives the request
deviations.why: Every institution decides what is asked of it under its own powers; no central administrator works another institution's cases.

deviations.what: The receiving institution's referral procedure (referral.<institution>, lib/casework/referral.ts) carries this form's work: a referral is opened from the referring institution's own case (engine refer(), linked both ways) and accepted, reported or declined there; its link by identity to this library form is not built
deviations.why: Referrals between institutions are cases (CLAUDE.md); the referral template predates the library and carries no form contract yet.

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it

library.intended: The receiving institution's referral procedure (referral.<institution>, report or decline): its link by identity to this library form is not built

en.length: The referral (its case reference) is too long.

en.required: Enter report to the referring institution.
en.length: Report to the referring institution is too long.

hint.en: Recorded by the platform when the form is received.
